ada_cs_ops: Heads-up — proposing a small revamp to the Health Score logic and playbook triggers to cut down on false renewal-risk alerts. Put a short proposal here: https://intranet.redwood/cs/healthscore-proposal. Need quick sync and sign-off.
ryan_dataeng: Can you list the specific metric weight changes and which tables we'll need to touch? Also any sample queries to validate?
ada_cs_ops: Sure — main changes: downweight NPS by 30%, upweight 30/60/90-day product usage signals, add a dedupe step for CRM contacts before scoring. Quick validation SQL: ```
-- avg weekly active events per account
SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) / 7.0 AS avg_daily_users
FROM events
WHERE event_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
marc_prodops: Noted — last quarter we saw a spike in churn flags pegged to duplicate accounts created by the Pardot sync. We should run a dedupe job before the nightly score. Anyone with objections to a one-off immediate dedupe + nightly autosync?
liz_onboarding: Agree on dedupe. Also we should tweak the onboarding playbook trigger: if account has no product activity and no touch for 14 days, kick the "engage-onboarding" playbook. That should reduce long-tail stuck accounts. Can the playbook read activity signals from the events table?
ada_cs_ops: Yes — playbook can subscribe to the events stream or pull from the materialized view. Proposed playbook flow: 1) dedupe pass, 2) recalc health score, 3) if score <= 35 AND last_touch >= 14 days AND product_activity_30d = 0 -> trigger engage-onboarding. Example trigger command we use with the automation runner: ```
playbook-bot trigger --name engage-onboarding --account {{account_id}} --reason "no-activity-14d-post-dedupe"
```
playbook-bot: Scheduled: nightly job "healthscore-v2" will run at 03:00 PT starting next Wednesday. One-off dedupe job queued for immediate run.
sam_support: For reporting: can we add a regression alert if the number of "renewal-risk" labels changes >15% week-over-week after rollout? Preferably post to #customer-success-alerts and create a PagerDuty if >40%.
ada_cs_ops: Good call. I'll add a weekly diff metric and a Grafana panel. I'll also update the playbook runbook with rollback steps. Will open PR in crm-cleanup with the dedupe SQL + tests. Planning the rollout for Wed 03:30 PT once dataeng gives a smoke test pass.
ryan_dataeng: SGTM. I'll add a smoke test that runs the dedupe and a sample score calc for 50 random accounts and upload logs to s3://redwood-cs/healthscore/v2-smoke/1864567890.log. Example log line: `2026-03-20T10:42:11Z INFO dedupe: merged 47 dup contacts for 12 accounts`
ada_cs_ops: Thanks — I'll ping product and support once the PR is up. If anyone wants to tweak thresholds, speak now; otherwise I'll merge tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
